intro: The Wand magnetic label is where function meets creativity. Stick it, write on it, move it around—this reusable label makes organising simple while giving your kitchen or office a stylish edge.

features.title: Stays in place, so you stay organised
features.text: A strong magnetic back keeps the label securely attached to any flat metal surface, making organisation effortless.

features.title: Removes easily without the mess
features.text: Need to rearrange? The label detaches smoothly without leaving marks or residue, so you can reposition it anytime.

features.title: A fun, bottle-inspired design
features.text: Combining function with style, our uniquely shaped label adds a creative touch to your fridge, kitchen, or workspace.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Wand Magnetic Label
